name: lab-studio
description: Copilot Lab Studio — run labs 01-05 of the Everything GitHub Copilot workshop entirely in the browser, backed by a live Copilot SDK session.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
